outcome: punctate white matter lesions (PWMLs) on brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)
cohort: Newborns who were at least 37 weeks of gestation, including those with prenatal opioid exposure and unexposed controls, participated in the study.
finding: Prenatal opioid exposure is associated with an increased risk of punctate white matter lesions (PWMLs) in newborns, with methadone exposure being significantly worse than buprenorphine.
